svg.title: nettwin · live run · 019-nft-nat-missing
svg.desc: A real NetTwin run replayed as a terminal: a fault is planted on the twin, the Claude Code agent team investigates and fixes it, an isolated verifier checks the fix, and the harness scores the result.

text.tspan: · twin: 5 FRR routers, a VLAN switch, 4 hosts (containerlab on WSL2)
NOC ticket: guest users on VLAN 20 cannot reach the internet although they reach their
gateway and the corporate side of the network. Corporate users reach the internet
normally and the ISP reports no change on their side.
The agent team takes the ticket (claude -p /diagnose, Sonnet)
· L2 investigation of guest VLAN 20 outage
· L3 investigation of guest VLAN 20 outage
show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors 203.0.113.2 advertised-routes
· Apply fix for missing guest BGP redistribution
· Verify guest VLAN fix in isolation
· Retry fix using NAT instead of BGP leak
nft add rule ip nat postrouting ip saddr 10.0.20.0/24 oifname "eth3"
route_diff before → after no route changes
Scored by the harness from the twin's own state, not the agents' report
· wall clock 6 min 43 s · twin reset to golden
